source: Static analysis of reverse-engineered/decompiled/60E15120_N3J1E + reverse-engineered/disassembly/60E15120_N3J1E/firmware_disassembly.asm + raw ROM bytes (submodules/Mazda_RX8_PCM_ReverseEngineering/Stock_ROMs/60E15120_N3J1E.bin, SHA-256 a7cd953c2a87af12ee2814a95c958dc23959d352ef9c5e7f82b8ab8952f264f1) + upstream dumps Data_binaries/RX8_93c56_ECU_IC420_Read.bin (SHA-256 64b13ddf353a06976729114179204f56b7a2869ea891f3f9d9400a2a56d205e3) and se3p_ecm_eeprom.bin (d7f4bb0a289f086610d8a9aafac58f6329b96c5be96ec75f7aef7418cf77c264). Report: eeprom_content_map_report.md.

0x00-0x01.evidence: 5a ff in both dumps; boot param index 0 len 4 -> 0xffffc26c (0x3599c)

0x02-0x09.evidence: 8 B per-ECU; device words 0x6010000-0x6040000 in 0x375c0; RX8 d3 d7 1a ef 41 3d 15 00

0x0c-0x15.evidence: param indices 0xc-0x14 (0x3599c/0x35a8c); identical in both dumps

0x16-0x19.evidence: per-ECU; words 0x60b0000/0x60c0000 in 0x375c0; RX8 8d fd 47 da

0x20-0x63.evidence: 34 x (u8 value, u8 flag); bulk 0x20 len 0x44 by 0x27b8e, value=-63+raw*0.5 (pools 0x27c84/0x27c80), save 0x279d8

0x6e-0x76.evidence: 9 B UDS-served (0x5b704); erased in both dumps

0x80-0x90.evidence: 17 ASCII; upper half 0x80-0xff UDS dump 0x5b5d4; RX8 'JM1FE173940102548'

0x9f.evidence: bit0 read by 0x5e748; RX8 fe, SE3P ff

0xa0-0xfb.evidence: all ff in both dumps; bulk-covered by 0x5b482 (0x64,0x9c)

0xfc-0xfd.evidence: per-ECU (RX8 ff 0c, SE3P 5f 41); no ROM consumer this pass

000375c0.evidence: Reads device words 0x6010000-0x6040000 (chip 0x02-0x09, 8-byte immo key), 0x60b0000/0x60c0000 (0x16-0x19 immo code), 0x6050000 (0x0a-0x0b status) via e2ram_read_word 0xbdfa under mask 0x10 with 0xbed8 busy checks; all-0x00/all-0xff patterns -> erased flags 0xffffc1d5-0xffffc1d8; gated by ref_securityNotUnlocked(1) and DAT_ffffd1ce. Called from 0x34a04 (boot, near ref_ImmoSomethingOrOther__ 0x349e4).

00027b8e.evidence: e2ram_bulk_read_into_shadow(0x20,0x44) then 0x22 iterations of e2ram_cached_byte_read(0x20+2i,..,2): value = rx8_decode_u8_affine(0x3f000000, 0xc27c0000, raw) = -63 + raw*0.5 (pools 0x27c84/0x27c80) -> float cells 0xffff8108+8i (+value) and 0xffff8328+8i (-value), flag byte (0xff->0) -> 0xffff8548+2i and 0xffff85d0+2i via ref_updateMemoryAtAddress_*. Called from 0x2874c/0x288be.

000279d8.evidence: Reverse of 0x27b8e: 0x22 iterations reading float cells 0xffff8108+8i and byte cells 0xffff8548+2i, rx8_encode_u8_affine_saturate(val, 0x3f000000, 0xc27c0000), e2ram_shadow_byte_write(0x20+2i,..,2), flush FUN_000378dc(0x20,0x44,3); only when engine not running (engine_running_flag_ffffaa68==0) and DAT_ffffb6c7==1, timeout DAT_ffffba16 < 0x4e2. Called from 0x288be.

00027d06.evidence: On engine stop (engine_running_flag_ffffaa68==1 && engine_stopped_latch_ffffa41c==1 && DAT_ffffba20==1) after DAT_ffffba1d reaches 0x14: writes (encode(0.0)=0x7e, flag 0) pairs to shadow 0x20+2i (rx8_encode_u8_affine_saturate(0, 0x3f000000, 0xc27c0000)) i.e. clears the learned table at key-off. Called from 0x288be.

000378dc.evidence: Sets up a shadow->chip flush: DAT_ffffc48e = start>>1, DAT_ffffc490 = end word, mode in DAT_ffffc49c (1: read-verify 0xffffc288/0xffffc28b, 2: 0xffffc289/0xffffc28c, 3: 0xffffc28a/0xffffc28d), DAT_ffffc496 = start byte, DAT_ffffc4a1 = busy. Processed by the state machine 0x379e4 (called from 0x38082). Callers incl. 0x279d8 (0x20,0x44,3), 0x5e8a4 (0x78,2).

0005b5d4.evidence: e2ram_cached_byte_read(0x80, buf, 0x80) then ref_setupForUdsResponse_(svc, buf, 0x80): returns EEPROM bytes 0x80-0xff (128 B, VIN at 0x80-0x90) as a UDS response. Inherited ref_grablast28ByteFromE2 name was wrong about the length/offset.

0005e664.evidence: Reads chip 0x64 (len 3) -> DAT_ffffd394 (+0x20), 0x68 (1) -> DAT_ffffd39a, 0x6a (2) -> DAT_ffffd398 (u16), 0x6c (1) -> DAT_ffffd39b via e2ram_cached_byte_read 0x37ef0. RX8 dump: 0x64-0x66='13H', 0x68='6', 0x6a-0x6b='02', 0x6c='0'.

0005b704.evidence: e2ram_cached_byte_read(0x6e, buf, 9); ref_setupForUdsResponse_(svc, buf, 9). Chip 0x6e-0x76 is erased (0xff) in both upstream dumps.

000543e4.evidence: e2ram_cached_byte_read(0x95, local, 1); byte == '*' (0x2a) -> DAT_ffffd1b5 = 0 (default tire size), else DAT_ffffd1b5 = 1. Inherited ref_getTireSizeChecksumthing_ confirmed. Chip 0x95 = 0x2a in both dumps.

0005de74.evidence: e2ram_cached_byte_read(0x9a, &local, 2) -> tire_revolutions_per_mile_ffffd380 (u16 BE); tolerance band vs 0x3727c5ac -> DAT_ffffd382. Inherited ref_getTireSize confirmed. Dumps: 0x030d = 781 rev/mile.

0005e748.evidence: e2ram_cached_byte_read(0x9f, local, 1); (val & 1) == 0 && DAT_ffffd1b5 == 0 && DAT_ffffd1b8 == 0 -> DAT_ffffd39c = 1. RX8 dump 0x9f = 0xfe, SE3P = 0xff.

0005b482.evidence: e2ram_bulk_read_into_shadow(100, 0x9c): bulk-reads chip 0x64-0xff (ID string, 9-byte field, VIN, tire fields, tail) into the shadow 0xffffc28e.

0000d408.evidence: If *(u16*)0xffff8000 == 0xaa55 (pool 0xd4f4) -> DAT_ffffa3fb = 1 (pool 0xd4ec); if set, call 0x9f4c -> 0x6360 -> 0x11492 (validate via 0x3e020, pool 0x11674); if ==1 write 0x55aa (pool 0xd4ea) to 0xffff8000 (pool 0xd4f0) and jmp 0x9f58 -> 0xabfa. Called from 0x6372 (pool 0x63e8) <- ref_getSensorStuff__ 0x60c8.

0000d44c.evidence: If DAT_ffffa3fb == 1 call 0x9f52 -> 0x6366 -> 0x113b8 (init fan-out); then write 0xaa55 (pool 0xd4f4) to 0xffff8000 (pool 0xd4f0). Called from ref_mainInit__ 0x61a8 (pool 0x6288).

00027024.evidence: Clears 2 rotor banks x 0x44 cells: float 0 -> 0xffff8108+8i+bank*0x220 (pool 0x27154) and flag 0 -> 0xffff8548+2i+bank*0x88 (pool 0x27158) via ref_updateMemoryAtAddress_*, plus DAT_ffff8658/865a/865c. Called from 0x2897e.

000270aa.evidence: Checksum-validates the same 2 banks x 0x44 learned-table cells via ref_validateAddressCopy_float/8bit (pools 0x27154/0x27158). Called from 0x28992 (validate fan-out 0x3e020).

0002711a.evidence: DAT_ffffb6c4 = rx8_lookup_2d_raw_u16(engine_speed_rpm_ffffb548, tbl 0x6a694 [17 cells, RPM axis 0x755dc = 0,1125,1750,...,8750, identity u16 data 0x75620]) + 17*load_band; load bands from engine_load_ffffc0b4 vs 0.4/0.65/3.0 (float pools 0x755a4/0x755a8/0x755ac): <0.4 -> +0, <0.65 -> +0x11, <3.0 -> +0x22, else +0x33 (rx8_add_u16_saturate 0x2460, pool 0x2724c). Cell = rpm_cell(0..16) + 17*load_band(0..3). Called from 0x287aa.

000271b0.evidence: rpm_cell = DAT_ffffb6c4 mod 17 (div FUN_00003fe8, pool 0x27258); DAT_ffffb8f0 = lookup_2d_descriptor_scaled(rpm_cell, tbl 0x6a6a0 [axis 0x75644 = 0..16, data 0x75688 = RPM breakpoints 750..9000]) = cell RPM breakpoint; reads flag_a + (cell-1)*2 / cell*2 / (cell+1)*2 + (DAT_ffffb660&1)*0x88 (pool 0x27270 = 0xffff8548) and sets DAT_ffffb6c6 = 1 only if the cell flag is set and a learned neighbour cell covers the current RPM (DAT_ffffb8f0). Called from 0x287aa.

000276ec.evidence: If DAT_ffffba04!=0 && DAT_ffffba06==0 && DAT_ffffb8f0-100.0 <= engine_speed_rpm_ffffb548 < DAT_ffffb8f0+100.0 (100.0 = float pool 0x755d0): bumps counter DAT_ffffb8f4[bank*0x44+cell] (pool 0x277f0) and stores DAT_ffffba2c into live cell DAT_ffffb6cc[bank*0x44+cell] (pool 0x277f8), first time directly, later via rx8_first_order_filter k=0.031 (pool 0x755d4), eps 1e-5 (pool 0x277fc); bank = DAT_ffffb660&1, cell = DAT_ffffb6c4. Called from 0x287aa.

00027808.evidence: Every 0xb ticks (DAT_ffffba04, pool 0x2791c): for 2 banks x 0x44 cells, if counter DAT_ffffb8f4[bank*0x44+cell] (pool 0x27928) > 0x1d: flag==0 -> copy live float DAT_ffffb6cc (pool 0x2792c) into value cell 0xffff8108+cell*8+bank*0x220 (pool 0x27938) and set flag 0xffff8548+cell*2+bank*0x88 = 1 (pool 0x27934); else filter the stored value toward the live one (rx8_first_order_filter 0x3db54, k=0.125, eps 1e-5 pool 0x27930). Then calls 0x27eec for cells 0..2 ((0x7>>cell)&1, pool 0x27a20). Called from 0x288be.

00027eec.evidence: For bank 0..1 (mov #0x2 loop) and j 0..2 (mov #0x3 loop): copies the 2-byte flag cell at flag_a+param*0x88+param*2 to flag_a+param*0x88+(param+0x11*(j+1))*2 (bases pools 0x27fa4 = 0xffff8108 / 0x27fa8 = 0xffff8548, stride 0x11 via rx8_add_u8_saturate 0x2478 pool 0x27fac); mirrors learned flags from cell p to p+0x11/+0x22/+0x33 within each rotor bank. Called from 0x27808.

00028198.evidence: Reads the learned value for cell DAT_ffffb6c4: 0xffff8108+cell*8 (pool 0x282b8) when DAT_ffffb660&1==0, else +0x220 (value_neg 0xffff8328) -> DAT_ffffba64+4*parity; interpolates between adjacent RPM cells via 0x28484 using the tbl 0x6a6a0 axis/data arrays; computes DAT_ffffba2c = (DAT_ffffb668 - (DAT_ffffb680-DAT_ffffb668)/6.0) - DAT_ffffb664 (sector-speed ring copies from 0x26940) and DAT_ffffba30 = DAT_ffffba2c - learned_value. Called from 0x287aa.

00028484.evidence: Fetches two neighbouring learned floats: base 0xffff8108 (pool 0x2850c) + bank*0x220 (mov.w pool 0x284f6) + cell*8, via ref_readValue_float_DEFAULTVAL_ADDRESS 0x3dc22 (pool 0x28508); returns them for RPM interpolation. Called from 0x28198.

0002837c.evidence: Per rotor bank (DAT_ffffb660&1): if DAT_ffffb6c6==1, filters DAT_ffffba30 into DAT_ffffba34 / 0xffffba38 (rx8_first_order_filter k=0.125, eps 1e-5), else 0; DAT_ffffba3c = bank value, DAT_ffffba40 = max(0, DAT_ffffba3c). Called from 0x287aa.

ffff8000.evidence: Firmware-written magic of the E2 window 0xffff8000-0xffff80ff: 0xd44c writes 0xaa55, 0xd408 checks it and rewrites 0x55aa (pools 0xd4f4/0xd4ea, base 0xd4f0). Window holds 8-byte checksummed cells (float +0, u16 cksum +4/+6 = ~(lo16+hi16)) via 0x3dc22/0x3dcd0; 241 pc-relative literal refs land in 0xffff8000-0xffff80ff.

ffff8108.evidence: Learned-table decoded float cells (+value = -63 + raw*0.5) from chip pairs 0x20+2i, written by 0x27b8e/0x279d8; cleared in 2x0x44 pattern by 0x27024.

ffff8328.evidence: Negated copies of the learned-table floats (0xffff8108 mirrored at -value), written by 0x27b8e.

ffffb6c4.evidence: Current learned-table cell = rpm_cell(0..16) + 17*load_band(0..3), computed by 0x2711a from engine_speed_rpm_ffffb548 (tbl 0x6a694) and engine_load_ffffc0b4 (bands 0.4/0.65/3.0). Consumed by 0x271b0/0x276ec/0x28198.

ffffb660.evidence: DAT_ffffb660 = DAT_ffffa3b0 = ATUII sector index 0..5 (set in the CMI10B sector ISR); &1 selects the rotor bank in the learned table (0x271b0/0x276ec/0x28198): bank 0 reads value_pos 0xffff8108, bank 1 reads value_neg 0xffff8328.

ffffb6cc.evidence: Live (RAM-only) learned values per rotor bank x cell, written by 0x276ec from DAT_ffffba2c when |rpm - cell breakpoint| <= 100; copied into the chip-backed cells by 0x27808 once counter DAT_ffffb8f4 > 0x1d.

ffffb8f4.evidence: Per bank x cell learn counters bumped by 0x276ec; 0x27808 persists the live cell into the learned table when the counter exceeds 0x1d.

ffffba2c.evidence: Learn value computed by 0x28198 = (DAT_ffffb668 - (DAT_ffffb680-DAT_ffffb668)/6.0) - DAT_ffffb664, a sector-speed-ring deviation term (ring 0xffffa390..0xffffa3ac copied by 0x26940); learned into the table cell by 0x276ec.

learned_table_pairs.format: 34 x (u8 value, u8 flag) at chip 0x20-0x63; value = -63 + raw*0.5; flag 0xff -> 0 (not learned), 1 = learned
learned_table_pairs.index: cell = rpm_cell + 17*load_band; rpm_cell = lookup(engine_speed_rpm, tbl 0x6a694) 0..16; load_band from engine_load: <0.4 -> 0, <0.65 -> 1, <3.0 -> 2, else 3 (0x2711a); only bands 0-1 (pairs 0..33) are chip-persisted, bands 2-3 live in RAM cells 34..67 only
learned_table_pairs.rotor: pair i feeds both rotor banks: +value at 0xffff8108+8i (even sector parity, DAT_ffffb660&1==0) and -value at 0xffff8328+8i (odd parity); flags at 0xffff8548+2i and 0xffff85d0+2i (0x27b8e load / 0x279d8 save)
